content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-201. - Legislative declaration.

             …

faqs.a:
The city council hereby finds and declares as a matter of legislative determination
               that the unauthorized use of motor vehicles in Arvada has risen substantially and
               that such unauthorized use often contributes to or makes possible other criminal activity.
               In addition, city council finds and declares that many crimes involving the unauthorized
               use of a motor vehicle begin with a vehicle that is taken in Arvada and later located
               in Arvada. It is the intent of city council, and council finds it necessary, to exercise
               to the fullest extent possible its authority to provide for the regulation and control
               of the unauthorized use of motor vehicles.
(Ord. No. 4006, § 2, 6-26-2006)
